title: 3DBAG Labs card catalogue
description: A collection of cards displayed on the 3DBAG Labs page.

date_added.description: Date on which the card was added, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

title.description: Short title displayed as the card heading.

description.description: Short card summary of no more than 140 whitespace-separated words.
description.$comment: The 140-word limit is enforced by hooks.py because standard JSON Schema has no portable maxWords keyword.

link.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL opened by the card's Visit button.

image.description: Relative path to the card image under docs/. The card displays it at approximately 600px wide by 350px high.

authors.description: One or more names of the people or teams responsible for the card.

contact.description: Email address shown as the card's contact link.

in_3dbag.description: Whether the experiment or content is included in 3DBAG.

archived.description: Whether the card represents archived content.
